## Summary

Describe the problem, the smallest safe change, and its storage-lifecycle
impact.

## Safety and provenance checklist

- [ ] I created this contribution or have the right to submit it.
- [ ] Every commit contains a DCO `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private infrastructure identities,
      customer data, proprietary source, or unredacted diagnostic evidence.
- [ ] I did not remove applicable copyright, license, attribution, or trademark
      notices.
- [ ] Modified branding does not imply an official or BASTRIX-certified build.
- [ ] Mutation-path changes include fail-closed regression coverage.
- [ ] Partial or ambiguous failure preserves data instead of guessing that
      cleanup is safe.

By submitting this pull request, I acknowledge the contribution terms in
[`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the separate brand-use rules in
[`TRADEMARKS.md`](../TRADEMARKS.md).
